channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: U.S. special forces heli seen alongside sanctioned tanker
item.description: An American military helicopter believed to be linked to U.S. special operations forces has been pictured operating alongside the sanctioned supertanker Marinera in the North Atlantic. The post U.S. special forces heli seen alongside sanctioned tanker first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. seizes sanctioned tanker in North Atlantic
item.description: The United States has seized the sanctioned supertanker Bella 1 in the North Atlantic, U.S. European Command said on Tuesday, confirming the culmination of days of heightened surveillance and military-backed enforcement activity. The post U.S. seizes sanctioned tanker in North Atlantic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK confirms military support for U.S. seizure of tanker
item.description: Britain confirmed on Wednesday that it provided military support to the United States during the seizure of the sanctioned oil tanker Bella 1 in the North Atlantic. The post UK confirms military support for U.S. seizure of tanker first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Key Channel boat supplier jailed after NCA-led probe
item.description: A man described by the National Crime Agency as its top global target for organised immigration crime has been jailed for supplying boats and engines used in thousands of small-boat crossings of the English Channel. The post Key Channel boat supplier jailed after NCA-led probe first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. accelerating pace of intercepter missile production
item.description: Lockheed Martin has signed a framework agreement with the U.S. Department of War aimed at accelerating production of PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement interceptors, with annual output planned to rise substantially. The post U.S. accelerating pace of intercepter missile production first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Babcock, Frankenburg to containerise anti-drone missiles
item.description: Babcock has signed a memorandum of understanding with Frankenburg Technologies to explore the development of a maritime counter-drone air defence system aimed at addressing the growing use of one-way attack drones. The post Babcock, Frankenburg to containerise anti-drone missiles first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: AN/AQS-24 paired with US Navy drone vessel
item.description: Northrop Grumman has demonstrated the integration of its AN/AQS-24 minehunting system with a U.S. Navy Mine Countermeasures Unmanned Surface Vehicle, completing initial open-water testing within 45 days of contract award, according to the company. The post AN/AQS-24 paired with US Navy drone vessel first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: QinetiQ secures £67m role in Royal Navy laser weapon effort
item.description: QinetiQ has been awarded a £67 million contract to support the delivery of the UK’s first laser directed energy weapons to Royal Navy platforms, with initial integration planned from 2027. The post QinetiQ secures £67m role in Royal Navy laser weapon effort first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Italian SOF test F-35 integration for NATO ACE concept
item.description: The Italian Air Force has completed a special operations exercise demonstrating the integration of special forces with fourth- and fifth-generation air assets in support of NATO’s Agile Combat Employment concept. The post Italian SOF test F-35 integration for NATO ACE concept first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: F-35 pilots test CCA teaming in U.S. Navy simulation
item.description: U.S. Navy F-35 pilots have completed a tactical demonstration focused on integrating crewed fighters with the U.S. Navy’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft inside the Joint Simulation Environment. The post F-35 pilots test CCA teaming in U.S. Navy simulation first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
